response.sql: WITH rating_averages AS (SELECT rating, AVG(replacement_cost) AS avg_replacement_cost, AVG(rental_rate / rental_duration) AS avg_rental_price_per_day FROM film GROUP BY rating), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_rental_price_per_day) AS plain_avg_daily_price_across_ratings FROM rating_averages) SELECT ra.rating, ra.avg_replacement_cost, ra.avg_rental_price_per_day, ra.avg_rental_price_per_day / o.plain_avg_daily_price_across_ratings AS ratio_to_plain_avg_across_ratings FROM rating_averages ra CROSS JOIN overall o ORDER BY ra.rating

assumptions.assumption: Treat per-day rental price as each film's rental_rate divided by its rental_duration, then average those per-film daily prices within each rating; the comparison baseline is the unweighted mean of the rating-level averages.
